watch.hypothesis: Bank leadership may be starting to fade relative to Innovative Pharma & CXO, but no handoff is confirmed.
watch.evidence: Banks lead by only 0.01 and are crowded, while pharma is nearly tied. However, banks retain materially stronger breadth (0.889 versus 0.643) and durability (0.73 versus 0.60), so the prevailing leadership remains intact.
watch.confirm_condition: By 2026-10-31, pharma holds the top rank across consecutive readings while maintaining or improving breadth, and bank breadth and durability decline—not merely its score.
watch.retire_condition: Retire the watch if banks rebuild a clear score margin while breadth remains near current levels, or if pharma loses breadth or eligibility.
